##### Project general facts

Lumena Alta by Omniyat is a mixed-use commercial tower conceived as the companion to the Lumena tower, completing a signature pair of office landmarks. Its twisted, spiralling façade of curved metallic fins wraps the glass shaft and is shaped to catch and refract light by day and to glow from within at night. The tower combines shell-and-core office units with private terraces, full-floor offices on selected levels, retail units at its base and a lifestyle hotel at the crown. The design targets LEED Platinum, WELL Building Platinum, WiredScore Platinum and SmartScore Platinum certifications, and the building runs on a smart building management system.

Office occupiers share an executive recreational level with a high-performance fitness centre, an indoor lap pool and vitality pools, as well as a wellness and spa level with treatment rooms, hydrotherapy and specialised therapies. Outdoor rejuvenation terraces and landscaped sky gardens take these spaces into the open air. The executive business centre brings together private boardrooms, conference and events space, co-working facilities and barista lounges. The hotel adds a sky lobby and deck, the Horizon Spa, a sky pool and bar and a signature sky restaurant with panoramic views. Omniyat manages round-the-clock security, concierge, doorman and porter services, and valet, guest and retail parking.

Office interiors are delivered in shell-and-core condition and come unfurnished, which leaves the layout and fit-out to each occupier. Office terraces are finished in stone or high-grade porcelain with soft landscaping, and developer washrooms are provided on every office floor. Units are arranged around a central core with generous ceiling heights and wide glazing that opens them to city and sea views. Arrival halls rise across several storeys beneath sculptural features, with lounges and upper-level terraces continuing the sequence, while the hotel's sky lobby is carved out of the twisted façade itself.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is Dubai's central business district, set along the Dubai Canal between Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Its gateway area faces Sheikh Zayed Road, a short drive from Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai Opera and the Dubai Fountain. DIFC and the Museum of the Future lie a few minutes along the same corridor, while City Walk, Dubai Design District and the Marasi Bay waterfront are close by. The district combines corporate towers, hotels, canal-side promenades and residential buildings, giving companies a central address with the city's main business and cultural destinations all within easy reach.

Business Bay Metro Station on the Red Line serves the district's gateway, and Al Khaleej Al Tejari Street and Financial Centre Street link it to the surrounding road network. Dubai International Airport is a short drive away, with Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport reachable along Sheikh Zayed Road. The Opus by Omniyat, home to ME Dubai Hotel and restaurants such as ROKA, The MAINE and Le Relais de l'Entrecôte, anchors the local dining scene. Souk Al Bahar, Time Out Market and the shops of Dubai Mall add further retail, dining and leisure options within the wider area.

Business Bay attracts regional headquarters of global enterprises, hedge funds, technology firms and legal practices, which supports steady demand for prime office space. Office towers that pair direct metro access with hotel-grade services and recognised sustainability and connectivity certifications sit at the upper end of this market. For investors, office space at the gateway to the district offers exposure to corporate tenants seeking a prominent central address next to Downtown Dubai and DIFC, together with access to the hospitality, dining and lifestyle offer of the surrounding area.
